description: Storage-abstraction core: the SnapshotStore seam + change-detection. This is the foundation the serverless design rests on (the SQLite-persistence assumption is SUPERSEDED). Add a SnapshotStore Protocol with an offline InMemorySnapshotStore (default) and an UpstashSnapshotStore (Upstash Redis REST over stdlib urllib.request, no new dependency), a JSON codec for the change-relevant fields of canonical Events, a pure change-detection function, and a snapshot-backed run wrapper. SqliteRepository is untouched and keeps its tests green. REUSES verbatim: pipeline.run + RunReport, repository.get_events_for_day, Event.identity_key, orchestrator._tracked_value coercions, compute_identity_key. Ordered FIRST because FEAT-002 (cron route + run log) and FEAT-005 (serverless boot) depend on it. Independent of FEAT-003 (calendar) and FEAT-004 (maps).
steps: In vandy_food_radar/config.py add `@dataclass SnapshotConfig` with fields `upstash_rest_url: str = ""` and `upstash_rest_token: str = ""`, add `snapshot: SnapshotConfig = field(default_factory=SnapshotConfig)` to `Config`, and in `Config.from_env` read the plain env vars `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` and `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` (NOT VFR_-prefixed, since Upstash/Vercel set these names) into those fields when present. Keep defaults empty so the offline path is the default.

Create vandy_food_radar/store/snapshot.py. Define a `SnapshotStore` typing.Protocol with `save_snapshot(self, target_date: date, events: list[Event]) -> None` and `load_snapshot(self, target_date: date) -> list[Event] | None`. Add pure codec helpers `events_to_json(events: list[Event]) -> str` and `events_from_json(text: str) -> list[Event]` that serialize ONLY the change-detection fields: identity_key, title, event_date (isoformat), start_time/end_time (isoformat or null), location, verification_state (.value), score_total. Mirror the coercions in orchestrator._tracked_value and reconstruct Event with those fields on decode (leave other Event fields at their dataclass defaults). Use json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True). Add `InMemorySnapshotStore` holding a dict keyed by target_date.isoformat() storing the decoded events (round-trip through the codec so behavior matches Upstash).

In vandy_food_radar/store/snapshot.py add a minimal HTTP seam: define a small callable/Protocol `SnapshotHttp` with `post(self, url: str, token: str, command: list[str]) -> str | None` and a default `_UrllibSnapshotHttp` implementation using urllib.request (POST JSON body = command, header Authorization: Bearer {token}, short timeout), returning the response body text or None on any error (URLError/HTTPError/timeout/JSON). Then add `UpstashSnapshotStore(rest_url: str, rest_token: str, *, http: SnapshotHttp | None = None)` implementing SnapshotStore: save issues command ["SET", f"vfr:snapshot:{target_date.isoformat()}", events_to_json(events)] (best-effort; swallow failure), load issues ["GET", key], parses the Upstash REST envelope {"result": <json-string or null>}, and returns events_from_json(result) or None. ANY error (http None, missing/None result, JSON error) returns None from load and is swallowed on save so a KV outage never raises.

In vandy_food_radar/store/snapshot.py add `build_snapshot_store(config: Config) -> SnapshotStore` returning `UpstashSnapshotStore(config.snapshot.upstash_rest_url, config.snapshot.upstash_rest_token)` only when BOTH url and token are non-empty, else `InMemorySnapshotStore()`. Update vandy_food_radar/store/__init__.py to export SnapshotStore, InMemorySnapshotStore, UpstashSnapshotStore, build_snapshot_store, events_to_json, events_from_json (keep Repository, SqliteRepository exports).

Create vandy_food_radar/pipeline/change_detect.py. Define `class ChangeKind(StrEnum)` with NEW, TIME_CHANGED, VENUE_CHANGED, CANCELLED, UNCHANGED. Define `@dataclass ChangeFlag` (identity_key: str, kind: ChangeKind). Define `detect_changes(fresh: list[Event], previous: list[Event] | None) -> dict[str, ChangeKind]` keyed by identity_key with precedence CANCELLED > TIME_CHANGED > VENUE_CHANGED > NEW > UNCHANGED: identity_key absent from previous -> NEW (E-9); current verification_state is CANCELLED and previous was not cancelled -> CANCELLED (E-4); start_time or end_time differs -> TIME_CHANGED (E-2); location differs -> VENUE_CHANGED (E-3); otherwise UNCHANGED. previous None or empty -> every fresh event is NEW. Add `@dataclass ChangeCounts` (new, time_changed, venue_changed, cancelled, unchanged: int = 0) and `tally_changes(changes: dict[str, ChangeKind]) -> ChangeCounts`. Deterministic, no I/O.

Create vandy_food_radar/pipeline/snapshot_run.py with `run_with_snapshot(window, *, repository, sources, location_provider, config, snapshot_store) -> tuple[RunReport, dict[str, ChangeKind]]`: call the existing pipeline.run(window, repository=..., sources=..., location_provider=..., config=...); read fresh = repository.get_events_for_day(window.target_date); previous = snapshot_store.load_snapshot(window.target_date); changes = detect_changes(fresh, previous); snapshot_store.save_snapshot(window.target_date, fresh); return (report, changes). No new SQLite writes.
Update vandy_food_radar/pipeline/__init__.py to export ChangeKind, ChangeFlag, ChangeCounts, detect_changes, tally_changes, run_with_snapshot (keep run, seed_demo, RunReport).

Add tests/test_snapshot_store.py: (a) events_to_json/events_from_json round-trip preserves the change-detection fields for a couple of built Events; (b) InMemorySnapshotStore save/load by date returns equivalent events and None for an unseen date; (c) UpstashSnapshotStore with a FAKE SnapshotHttp asserts save posts ["SET", "vfr:snapshot:2025-03-11", <json>] and load posts ["GET", key] and decodes the {"result": <json>} envelope; (d) UpstashSnapshotStore.load returns None when the fake http returns None or a null result (outage); (e) build_snapshot_store returns InMemorySnapshotStore when env unset and UpstashSnapshotStore when both Upstash env vars are set (build a Config with snapshot fields populated).

Add tests/test_change_detect.py: build small Event lists and assert detect_changes classifies NEW (absent in previous), TIME_CHANGED (start_time differs), VENUE_CHANGED (location differs), CANCELLED (verification_state CANCELLED and previously not), UNCHANGED (identical); previous=None -> all NEW; precedence: a cancelled event whose time also changed classifies CANCELLED. Assert tally_changes counts match.

Add tests/test_snapshot_run.py using SqliteRepository(':memory:') + InMemorySnapshotStore + build_sources(default_fetcher(Config())) over TARGET_DAY=date(2025,3,11): first run_with_snapshot -> every change is NEW; a second identical run -> every change UNCHANGED; using a _SingleRecordAdapter-style adapter (copy the pattern from tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py), a start_time change between runs -> TIME_CHANGED for that identity_key; assert the snapshot is repopulated each run (load_snapshot returns non-None after a run).
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest tests/test_snapshot_store.py tests/test_change_detect.py tests/test_snapshot_run.py -q` passes.
build_snapshot_store returns InMemorySnapshotStore when Upstash env vars are unset and UpstashSnapshotStore when both are set; no store touches the network in any test (http client injected/faked).
UpstashSnapshotStore.load returns None (never raises) on any HTTP/JSON error or null result; save is best-effort and never raises.
detect_changes is deterministic and classifies NEW/TIME_CHANGED/VENUE_CHANGED/CANCELLED/UNCHANGED with cancelled>time>venue>new>unchanged precedence; previous=None -> all NEW.
SqliteRepository and all 93 pre-existing tests are unchanged and still pass.
`make check` is green (ruff, black --check, mypy strict, pytest).
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_snapshot_store.py tests/test_change_detect.py tests/test_snapshot_run.py -q
findings: Public symbols FEAT-002/FEAT-005 import: from vandy_food_radar.store import SnapshotStore, InMemorySnapshotStore, UpstashSnapshotStore, build_snapshot_store, events_to_json, events_from_json. From vandy_food_radar.pipeline import ChangeKind, ChangeFlag, ChangeCounts, detect_changes, tally_changes, run_with_snapshot. The SnapshotHttp Protocol + _UrllibSnapshotHttp default live in vandy_food_radar.store.snapshot (import SnapshotHttp from there if you need to inject a fake). Config now has config.snapshot: SnapshotConfig(upstash_rest_url, upstash_rest_token); Config.from_env reads the PLAIN (non-VFR_-prefixed) env vars UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN. build_snapshot_store(config) returns UpstashSnapshotStore only when BOTH url+token are non-empty, else InMemorySnapshotStore (the offline default). GOTCHAS: (1) run_with_snapshot signature is run_with_snapshot(window, *, repository, sources, location_provider, config, snapshot_store) -> tuple[RunReport, dict[str, ChangeKind]]; it reuses pipeline.run verbatim and adds NO new SQLite writes -- change state lives only in the snapshot store. (2) The codec serializes ONLY change-detection fields (identity_key, title, event_date, start_time, end_time, location, verification_state, score_total); events_from_json returns Events with all OTHER fields at dataclass defaults (id='' , dedup_key=''), so never persist a decoded snapshot event back to SQLite. (3) UpstashSnapshotStore.load parses the Upstash REST envelope {"result": <json-string|null>} and returns None (never raises) on http None / null result / JSON error; save is best-effort and swallows all failures, so a KV outage degrades to all-events-NEW. (4) InMemorySnapshotStore round-trips through the JSON codec so its behavior matches Upstash. (5) detect_changes precedence is CANCELLED > TIME_CHANGED > VENUE_CHANGED > NEW > UNCHANGED; previous None/empty => all NEW. 116 tests pass (93 pre-existing + 23 new); make check green.
